english.note: Use 見識 for experience-based or firsthand awareness of something, rather than bare awareness of a fact.

examples.english: After travelling to several countries, I really broadened my knowledge.
examples.traditional: 去咗幾個國家旅行之後，我真係增廣咗見識。
